positions.as_written: Assess continuity bundle by bundle rather than for the ligament as a whole, which needs the oblique and axial images.
Check the line of the remaining fibres against the notch roof, because partially torn fibres often keep a normal line.
Use a fluid sensitive sequence for the oedema and an intermediate weighted one for the fibres, because the two questions need different contrast.
Compare with the posterior cruciate for buckling, which is a translation sign rather than a ligament sign.
